iconicAnchor.label: Century of the Child: construction toys
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: MoMA connects geometric construction toys with imaginative world-building, modular parts, and design education across the twentieth century.

sources.title: Century of the Child: Growing by Design, 1900–2000
supports: Construction toys use modular geometric elements to support imaginative building and learning through play.

sources.title: Playing with Modern Design
supports: Reductive colorful toy forms connect modern design vocabulary with creativity, play, and learning.
